reasons: The opinion states: "Given the above analysis, the discovery of cocaine on the defendant’s person was the result of a lawful search incident to arrest. We AFFIRM."
The opinion says the court found it unnecessary to address Terry because the agents were justified in conducting a full warrantless search under the search-incident-to-arrest doctrine.
The defendant admitted probable cause to search the vehicle, but the suppression issue resolved by the court was the search of his person, not an automobile-exception holding.
residual_risks: The page should avoid using the truncated ellipsis in the canonical holding field.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: State expressly that Anchondo is search-incident-to-arrest authority and only a cautionary non-automobile-exception reference.
